descriptions.cc39d_map_contains_8020e14c: Return whether the STLport unsigned-int map at owner +20 contains the key formed from the first object's 16-bit id at +8 (high half) and the second object's id at +8 (low half), using STLport's _Rb_tree find walk with reference-cast link accessors and const_iterator comparison against end(). Partial observed views; owner type, mapped type and sizeof unknown.
